violation_type.title: Space and Equipment - Workspace for Table-top Activities (26 TAC §744.2051(4))
violation_type.short_title: Space and Equipment - Workspace for Table-top Activities
violation_type.typical_finding: During inspection it was observed the operation did not have adequate tables and chairs for children in care.

finding_variants.text: During inspection it was observed the operation did not have adequate tables and chairs for children in care.
In one classroom there were no table top activities provided and the space was not properly set up for children.
There was  not enough tables and chairs for children to sit. There were five children standing due to not having a table to sit at or chairs accessible.
